=== FILE: verification_plan.json ===
{
  "format": "nirmaan.vplan",
  "version": 1,
  "requirements": [
    {"id": "IRQ-PARAM", "source": "interface_spec.md", "section": "1. Parameters", "text": "The block works for every `N` from 2 to 32, and bits `N` and up of the `ENABLE`, `MODE` and `PENDING` registers read as zero and ignore writes."},
    {"id": "IRQ-RESET", "source": "interface_spec.md", "section": "4.1 Reset and registers", "text": "While `rst_n` is low at a rising edge of `clk`, `ENABLE`, `MODE` and `PENDING` clear to zero and the remembered level of every source clears to zero."},
    {"id": "IRQ-REG-RW", "source": "interface_spec.md", "section": "4.1 Reset and registers", "text": "A write to `ENABLE` or `MODE` stores `wdata` bits `N-1` to 0 in that register."},
    {"id": "IRQ-READ", "source": "interface_spec.md", "section": "4.1 Reset and registers", "text": "A read never changes any register; `rdata` follows `addr` with no clock edge."},
    {"id": "IRQ-LEVEL", "source": "interface_spec.md", "section": "4.2 Detection", "text": "A high-level source sets its `PENDING` bit at every rising edge where its input is high."},
    {"id": "IRQ-EDGE", "source": "interface_spec.md", "section": "4.2 Detection", "text": "A rising-edge source sets its `PENDING` bit at a rising edge where its input is high and was low at the previous rising edge, so an input held high sets it once."},
    {"id": "IRQ-DETECT-DISABLED", "source": "interface_spec.md", "section": "4.2 Detection", "text": "Detection does not depend on `ENABLE`: a disabled source still sets its `PENDING` bit."},
    {"id": "IRQ-W1C", "source": "interface_spec.md", "section": "4.3 Clearing", "text": "A write to `PENDING` clears each bit written 1 and leaves each bit written 0 unchanged; it never sets a bit."},
    {"id": "IRQ-ACK", "source": "interface_spec.md", "section": "4.3 Clearing", "text": "A write to `CLAIM` acknowledges the source whose number is in `wdata` bits 4 to 0: that source's `PENDING` bit clears and no other bit changes; a number of `N` or more changes nothing."},
    {"id": "IRQ-SET-WINS", "source": "interface_spec.md", "section": "4.3 Clearing", "text": "A source detected at the same rising edge as a write that clears its bit keeps its `PENDING` bit set, so a high-level source acknowledged while its input is still high stays pending."},
    {"id": "IRQ-MASK", "source": "interface_spec.md", "section": "4.4 The interrupt and the claim", "text": "`irq` is high exactly when some source has both its `PENDING` and its `ENABLE` bit set, for high-level and rising-edge sources alike."},
    {"id": "IRQ-PRIORITY", "source": "interface_spec.md", "section": "4.4 The interrupt and the claim", "text": "`irq_id` is the lowest-numbered source whose `PENDING` and `ENABLE` bits are both set, so source 0 has the highest priority, and it is 0 while `irq` is low."},
    {"id": "IRQ-CLAIM", "source": "interface_spec.md", "section": "4.4 The interrupt and the claim", "text": "A read of `CLAIM` returns `irq` in bit 31 and `irq_id` in bits 4 to 0, with every other bit zero."},
    {"id": "IRQ-LATENCY", "source": "interface_spec.md", "section": "4.4 The interrupt and the claim", "text": "`irq` and `irq_id` follow the registers with no clock edge, so a source detected at one rising edge drives `irq` until the next."}
  ],
  "items": [
    {"id": "T-SMOKE", "kind": "test", "file": "tb_irq_ctrl.sv", "name": "test_smoke", "proves": ["IRQ-RESET", "IRQ-LEVEL", "IRQ-MASK"], "rationale": "Stimulus: reset, enable source 0, raise its input. Check: after reset all registers read 0; then PENDING[0] is set and irq is high. This shows the environment works end to end."},
    {"id": "T-PARAM-UNUSED-BITS", "kind": "test", "file": "tb_irq_ctrl.sv", "name": "test_param_unused_bits", "proves": ["IRQ-PARAM"], "rationale": "Stimulus: write all ones to ENABLE, MODE and PENDING, and drive every src bit high. Check: bits N and up read as zero. The test is run with N = 2, 8 and 32 so that the whole parameter range is exercised."},
    {"id": "T-PARAM-SWEEP", "kind": "test", "file": "tb_irq_ctrl.sv", "name": "test_param_sweep", "proves": ["IRQ-PARAM", "IRQ-PRIORITY"], "rationale": "Stimulus: random detection, enable and clear traffic. The test is run with N = 2, 8 and 32. Check: a reference model of all registers, irq and irq_id agrees at every cycle, including for the highest source N-1."},
    {"id": "T-RESET", "kind": "test", "file": "tb_irq_ctrl.sv", "name": "test_reset", "proves": ["IRQ-RESET"], "rationale": "Stimulus: put nonzero values in ENABLE, MODE and PENDING, then hold rst_n low for one edge. Check: all three read 0 and irq is low."},
    {"id": "T-RESET-EDGE-HISTORY", "kind": "test", "file": "tb_irq_ctrl.sv", "name": "test_reset_edge_history", "proves": ["IRQ-RESET", "IRQ-EDGE"], "rationale": "Stimulus: hold an edge-mode source high through reset, set MODE again, and keep the input high. Check: an edge is detected on the first edge after reset, because the remembered level was cleared to zero. A source held high therefore sets PENDING once."},
    {"id": "T-REG-RW", "kind": "test", "file": "tb_irq_ctrl.sv", "name": "test_reg_rw", "proves": ["IRQ-REG-RW"], "rationale": "Stimulus: write walking-ones, walking-zeros and random values to ENABLE and MODE. Check: each read returns wdata bits N-1 to 0."},
    {"id": "T-READ-NO-SIDE-EFFECT", "kind": "test", "file": "tb_irq_ctrl.sv", "name": "test_read_no_side_effect", "proves": ["IRQ-READ"], "rationale": "Stimulus: sweep addr over 0 to 3 for many cycles with we low and src held still. Check: no register changes; reading CLAIM does not acknowledge anything; rdata changes in the same cycle that addr changes."},
    {"id": "T-LEVEL", "kind": "test", "file": "tb_irq_ctrl.sv", "name": "test_level_detect", "proves": ["IRQ-LEVEL"], "rationale": "Stimulus: set a level-mode source high, clear PENDING while the input is still high, then drop the input and clear again. Check: the bit is set again after every edge while the input is high, and stays clear once the input is low."},
    {"id": "T-EDGE", "kind": "test", "file": "tb_irq_ctrl.sv", "name": "test_edge_detect", "proves": ["IRQ-EDGE"], "rationale": "Stimulus: drive an edge-mode source with a single-cycle pulse, a long high period, and toggling. Check: PENDING is set only on 0-to-1 transitions; when the source is held high and cleared, it is not set again."},
    {"id": "T-DETECT-DISABLED", "kind": "test", "file": "tb_irq_ctrl.sv", "name": "test_detect_disabled", "proves": ["IRQ-DETECT-DISABLED", "IRQ-MASK"], "rationale": "Stimulus: set ENABLE to 0 and pulse sources in both modes. Check: PENDING bits are set while irq stays low; enabling a source afterwards makes irq go high."},
    {"id": "T-W1C", "kind": "test", "file": "tb_irq_ctrl.sv", "name": "test_pending_w1c", "proves": ["IRQ-W1C"], "rationale": "Stimulus: set several PENDING bits, then write masks with mixed ones and zeros, including all zeros to a bit that is clear. Check: exactly the bits written 1 clear, and no bit is ever set by a write."},
    {"id": "T-ACK", "kind": "test", "file": "tb_irq_ctrl.sv", "name": "test_claim_ack", "proves": ["IRQ-ACK"], "rationale": "Stimulus: set several pending sources, then write their numbers to CLAIM, including numbers N through 31 and data with bits above 4 set. Check: only the named bit clears; an out-of-range number changes nothing; bits above 4 are ignored."},
    {"id": "T-SET-WINS-W1C", "kind": "test", "file": "tb_irq_ctrl.sv", "name": "test_set_wins_w1c", "proves": ["IRQ-SET-WINS"], "rationale": "Stimulus: write 1 to PENDING for a source on the same edge that source is detected, in level mode and in edge mode. Check: the bit stays set."},
    {"id": "T-SET-WINS-ACK", "kind": "test", "file": "tb_irq_ctrl.sv", "name": "test_set_wins_ack", "proves": ["IRQ-SET-WINS", "IRQ-ACK"], "rationale": "Stimulus: acknowledge a level-mode source through CLAIM while its input is high. Check: it stays pending and irq stays high."},
    {"id": "T-MASK", "kind": "test", "file": "tb_irq_ctrl.sv", "name": "test_irq_mask", "proves": ["IRQ-MASK"], "rationale": "Stimulus: go through combinations of PENDING and ENABLE for level and edge sources. Check: irq equals the OR of (PENDING & ENABLE) at every cycle."},
    {"id": "T-PRIORITY", "kind": "test", "file": "tb_irq_ctrl.sv", "name": "test_priority", "proves": ["IRQ-PRIORITY"], "rationale": "Stimulus: set several sources pending and enabled, then acknowledge them one at a time. Check: irq_id is always the lowest such source, and irq_id is 0 when irq is low. Also check that a pending source that is disabled does not win."},
    {"id": "T-CLAIM-READ", "kind": "test", "file": "tb_irq_ctrl.sv", "name": "test_claim_read", "proves": ["IRQ-CLAIM"], "rationale": "Stimulus: read CLAIM with irq low and with irq high for different ids. Check: bit 31 equals irq, bits 4 to 0 equal irq_id, and bits 30 to 5 are zero."},
    {"id": "T-LATENCY", "kind": "test", "file": "tb_irq_ctrl.sv", "name": "test_irq_latency", "proves": ["IRQ-LATENCY", "IRQ-READ"], "rationale": "Stimulus: sample irq, irq_id and rdata just after each edge where a source is detected, enabled or cleared. Check: the outputs change at that same edge, not one cycle later."},
    {"id": "T-ILLEGAL", "kind": "test", "file": "tb_irq_ctrl.sv", "name": "test_illegal_stimulus", "proves": ["IRQ-ACK", "IRQ-W1C", "IRQ-PARAM"], "rationale": "Error-stimulus focus area. Stimulus: CLAIM acknowledges for numbers N to 31, PENDING writes to unused bits, and writes on back-to-back cycles. Check: no state changes except those the spec allows."},
    {"id": "T-RANDOM", "kind": "test", "file": "tb_irq_ctrl.sv", "name": "test_random_regression", "proves": ["IRQ-RESET", "IRQ-REG-RW", "IRQ-READ", "IRQ-LEVEL", "IRQ-EDGE", "IRQ-DETECT-DISABLED", "IRQ-W1C", "IRQ-ACK", "IRQ-SET-WINS", "IRQ-MASK", "IRQ-PRIORITY", "IRQ-CLAIM", "IRQ-LATENCY"], "rationale": "Stress focus area. Stimulus: constrained-random src, writes, reads and resets. Check: a cycle-accurate scoreboard reference model compares every register and output."},
    {"id": "A-RESET", "kind": "assertion", "file": "irq_ctrl_sva.sv", "name": "a_reset_clears", "proves": ["IRQ-RESET"], "rationale": "If rst_n is low at an edge, then at the next cycle ENABLE, MODE and PENDING are zero."},
    {"id": "A-UNUSED-ZERO", "kind": "assertion", "file": "irq_ctrl_sva.sv", "name": "a_unused_bits_zero", "proves": ["IRQ-PARAM"], "rationale": "Bits N and up of ENABLE, MODE and PENDING are always zero. Proven formally with N = 2, 8 and 32."},
    {"id": "A-REG-RW", "kind": "assertion", "file": "irq_ctrl_sva.sv", "name": "a_reg_write_stores", "proves": ["IRQ-REG-RW"], "rationale": "A write with we high to addr 0 or addr 1 loads wdata[N-1:0] into ENABLE or MODE at the next cycle, when not in reset."},
    {"id": "A-READ-STABLE", "kind": "assertion", "file": "irq_ctrl_sva.sv", "name": "a_read_no_change", "proves": ["IRQ-READ"], "rationale": "With we low, ENABLE and MODE never change; PENDING only gains bits from detection. rdata always equals the register that addr selects, as a combinational check."},
    {"id": "A-LEVEL", "kind": "assertion", "file": "irq_ctrl_sva.sv", "name": "a_level_sets", "proves": ["IRQ-LEVEL", "IRQ-DETECT-DISABLED"], "rationale": "If MODE[i] is 0 and src[i] is high at an edge, PENDING[i] is set next cycle, whatever ENABLE is."},
    {"id": "A-EDGE", "kind": "assertion", "file": "irq_ctrl_sva.sv", "name": "a_edge_sets_once", "proves": ["IRQ-EDGE", "IRQ-DETECT-DISABLED"], "rationale": "If MODE[i] is 1, PENDING[i] rises only after a 0-to-1 transition of src[i] across consecutive edges, and every such transition sets it, whatever ENABLE is."},
    {"id": "A-W1C", "kind": "assertion", "file": "irq_ctrl_sva.sv", "name": "a_pending_w1c", "proves": ["IRQ-W1C"], "rationale": "After a PENDING write with no detection, the next PENDING equals the old PENDING with the bits written 1 cleared. No bit is ever set except by detection."},
    {"id": "A-ACK", "kind": "assertion", "file": "irq_ctrl_sva.sv", "name": "a_claim_ack", "proves": ["IRQ-ACK"], "rationale": "A CLAIM write clears only bit wdata[4:0] when that number is below N, and changes nothing when it is N or more, apart from detection."},
    {"id": "A-SET-WINS", "kind": "assertion", "file": "irq_ctrl_sva.sv", "name": "a_set_wins", "proves": ["IRQ-SET-WINS"], "rationale": "If detection and a clear (W1C or ACK) happen for the same bit at the same edge, the bit is set next cycle."},
    {"id": "A-MASK", "kind": "assertion", "file": "irq_ctrl_sva.sv", "name": "a_irq_mask", "proves": ["IRQ-MASK", "IRQ-LATENCY"], "rationale": "irq equals the OR of (PENDING & ENABLE) at all times, checked combinationally with no delay."},
    {"id": "A-PRIORITY", "kind": "assertion", "file": "irq_ctrl_sva.sv", "name": "a_irq_id_priority", "proves": ["IRQ-PRIORITY", "IRQ-LATENCY"], "rationale": "irq_id equals the index of the lowest set bit of PENDING & ENABLE, or 0 if no bit is set, at all times."},
    {"id": "A-CLAIM", "kind": "assertion", "file": "irq_ctrl_sva.sv", "name": "a_claim_read_format", "proves": ["IRQ-CLAIM"], "rationale": "When addr is 3, rdata equals {irq, 26'b0, irq_id}."},
    {"id": "A-OTHER-REGS", "kind": "assertion", "file": "irq_ctrl_sva.sv", "name": "a_rdata_mux", "proves": ["IRQ-READ", "IRQ-PARAM"], "rationale": "When addr is 0, 1 or 2, rdata equals ENABLE, MODE or PENDING, with zeros above bit N-1."},
    {"id": "C-MODE-X-DETECT", "kind": "coverage_point", "file": "irq_ctrl.sv", "name": "cp_mode_cross_detect", "proves": ["IRQ-LEVEL", "IRQ-EDGE", "IRQ-DETECT-DISABLED"], "rationale": "Cross of MODE, ENABLE and detection events for every source. Assumes the existing RTL file is named irq_ctrl.sv."},
    {"id": "C-SET-WINS", "kind": "coverage_point", "file": "irq_ctrl.sv", "name": "cp_detect_and_clear_same_edge", "proves": ["IRQ-SET-WINS"], "rationale": "Covers detection happening on the same edge as a W1C write and as a CLAIM acknowledge."},
    {"id": "C-PRIORITY", "kind": "coverage_point", "file": "irq_ctrl.sv", "name": "cp_irq_id_values", "proves": ["IRQ-PRIORITY", "IRQ-CLAIM"], "rationale": "Every irq_id value from 0 to N-1 seen while irq is high, with at least two competing sources."},
    {"id": "C-ACK-RANGE", "kind": "coverage_point", "file": "irq_ctrl.sv", "name": "cp_ack_number_range", "proves": ["IRQ-ACK"], "rationale": "Covers acknowledge numbers below N that are pending, below N that are not pending, and N or more."},
    {"id": "C-MASK", "kind": "coverage_point", "file": "irq_ctrl.sv", "name": "cp_pending_enable_cross", "proves": ["IRQ-MASK"], "rationale": "All four PENDING and ENABLE combinations per source, and irq toggling in both directions."},
    {"id": "C-RESET", "kind": "coverage_point", "file": "irq_ctrl.sv", "name": "cp_reset_with_state", "proves": ["IRQ-RESET"], "rationale": "Covers reset asserted while registers are nonzero and while an edge source is high."}
  ]
}
=== END FILE ===
